subject.title: [Feishu] 飞书群多机器人身份混乱问题

question: Which stable Feishu bot/account discriminator should become part of durable group session identity, and how should existing Feishu group session history be migrated or repaired?
rationale: The observable bug is clear, but the fix crosses durable session state and bot/account authorization boundaries where automation should not choose accountId versus appId versus platform bot identity or the upgrade behavior alone.

options.title: Account-scoped group sessions with migration
options.body: Include the normalized Feishu account boundary in group session identity and provide doctor or migration handling for existing group keys.

options.title: Platform app or bot identity scope
options.body: Use a proven Feishu platform identity such as appId or another stable bot identity if maintainers prefer platform semantics over OpenClaw account ids.

options.title: Defer to broader Feishu identity design
options.body: Keep this issue open until related Feishu mention, DM, and account-routing work converge on a shared identity model.

recommendation.title: Account-scoped group sessions with migration
recommendation.body: Include the normalized Feishu account boundary in group session identity and provide doctor or migration handling for existing group keys.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed the related Feishu multi-bot identity PR and identified the current-main identity decision surface as non-mechanical.
